:::{#def-derivative}
#### Derivative

If $f$ is differentiable at $c$ (@def-differentiable),
the number $f'(c)$ is the **derivative** of $f$ at $c$.
The **derivative** of $f$ is the function $f'$
whose value at each $x$ where $f$ is differentiable is $f'(x)$.
The derivative of $f$ is also written $\dif{f}{x}$ or $\dif{}{x} f(x)$.

:::
